name: 12 Piece Cake Decorating Set Frosting Icing Piping Bag Tips with Steel Nozzles. Reusable & Washable
description:
12-Piece Cake Decorating Set – Frosting Icing Piping Bag Tips with Steel Nozzles

Product Highlights:

Includes 12 high-quality stainless steel nozzles and 1 sturdy coupler

Made of durable stainless steel and food-grade plastic

Reusable and washable for multiple baking projects

Ideal for decorating cakes, cupcakes, and desserts

Perfect addition to any baking collection

Specifications:

Set contains 12 nozzles + 1 coupler

Nozzles crafted from high-quality stainless steel

Coupler made of safe, food-grade plastic

Description:
Elevate your baking with this versatile cake decorating set. Whether you want to create intricate frosting designs, sculpt cakes into creative shapes, or add a professional finishing touch, this set has you covered. Cake decorating is an art that allows you to transform plain cakes into visually stunning creations using icing, frosting, and other edible decorations. Durable, reusable, and easy to clean, this set is perfect for both beginners and experienced bakers.
